name: controls
source: program p; uses crt; var i:integer; begin write('Keys: '); for i:=1 to 7 do writeln(ord(readkey)) end.

name: chunk
source: program p; uses crt; var i:integer; begin for i:=1 to 9 do writeln(ord(readkey)) end.

name: complete_line
source: program p; uses crt; var n:integer; begin writeln(ord(readkey)); readln(n); writeln(n); writeln(ord(readkey)) end.

name: prefix
source: program p; uses crt; var s:string; begin writeln(ord(readkey)); readln(s); writeln(s); writeln(ord(readkey)) end.

name: prefix_eof
source: program p; uses crt; var s:string; begin writeln(ord(readkey)); readln(s); writeln(s) end.

name: eof
source: program p; uses crt; begin write('Key: '); writeln(ord(readkey)) end.

name: composition
source: program p; uses crt; var i:integer; begin for i:=1 to 3 do writeln(ord(readkey)) end.

name: borrowed_character
source: program p; uses crt; type R=record s:string[8] end; PRef=^R; var v:PRef; procedure accept(var c:char); begin c:=readkey end; begin new(v); v^.s:='abc'; accept(v^.s[2]); writeln(v^.s); dispose(v) end.

name: variant_with
source: program p; uses crt; type R=record case boolean of true:(c:char); false:(n:integer) end; var v:R; begin v.n:=7; with v do c:=readkey; writeln(v.c) end.

name: file_group
source: program p; uses crt; var f:text; s:string; begin assign(f,'result'); rewrite(f); write(f,readkey,readkey); close(f); reset(f); readln(f,s); writeln(s); close(f) end.
